title: Prognostic Association of the Two-Cycle On-Treatment CRAFITY Score in Advanced HCC: A Single-Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
snippet: The baseline CRAFITY score, derived from AFP and C-reactive protein, is a validated prognostic biomarker for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients receiving immunotherapy.
